title: Integrated Verbal Periphrases of Duration and Aspect

sections.content:
Combining periphrases allows you to articulate life stories with nuanced temporal precision:

• **Immediate past**: *Acabo de terminar mi carrera.* (I just finished my degree.)
• **Ongoing action**: *Llevo dos años buscando trabajo.* (I've been looking for work for two years.)
• **Negative duration**: *Llevo meses sin tener una entrevista.* (I haven't had an interview for months.)
• **Instantaneous trigger**: *Al ver esta oferta, me puse a escribir la solicitud.* (Upon seeing this offer, I set about writing the application.)

items.spanish: Acabamos de llegar a Valencia y ya llevamos dos horas paseando por la playa.
items.english: We just arrived in Valencia and we've already been strolling on the beach for two hours.

items.spanish: Al abrir la puerta, me puse a ordenar la habitación.
items.english: Upon opening the door, I set about tidying the room.

items.spanish: Llevaba meses sin verlo cuando nos encontramos por casualidad.
items.english: I hadn't seen him for months when we ran into each other by chance.

sections.content: Pay close attention to whether the following verb is a gerund (*-ando/-iendo*) or an infinitive (*-ar/-er/-ir*).
